objective_value: <float> Total cost of the schedule, combining the travel costs between consecutive trips and the per-vehicle depot dispatch penalty across all routes.

routes.depot: <int> Identifier of the depot from which this vehicle is dispatched and to which it returns.
routes.tasks: <list[int]> Ordered sequence of trip identifiers served by this vehicle between leaving and returning to the depot.
routes.cost: <float> Total cost of this single vehicle route, including the depot dispatch penalty and the travel costs between the depot and trips and between consecutive trips.
